nodes.description: Private uint256 state variable holding the pseudo-random number generated from block.timestamp (now) via keccak256 % 10 + 1.
Public uint256 state variable tracking the contract balance / accumulated prize pool.
Public uint256 state variable holding the minimum bet allowed to start a game, default 0.1 ether.
Address state variable initialized to msg.sender at deployment; grants privileged access.
Public GameHistory[] array storing each player address and guessed number.
External onlyOwner function that updates minBet to an arbitrary value supplied by the owner.
Payable public entry point: records the player's guess in log, compares it with randomNumber, transfers the contract balance to the winner, then regenerates randomNumber and prizeFund.
Public onlyOwner function transferring an arbitrary amount _am from the contract to owner.
Fallback function that accepts plain Ether transfers with no logic.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner before the decorated function body executes.
Caller-controlled address used for owner initialization, the onlyOwner check, the recorded player address and the prize transfer recipient.
Miner-influenced timestamp (now) used as the sole entropy source for the winning number.
msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) sends the whole contract balance to the caller inside startGame.
owner.transfer(_am) sends an owner-chosen amount out of the contract inside withdaw.
uint256(keccak256(now)) % 10 + 1 derives the winning number and the reset value from block.timestamp, making the randomness predictable/front-runnable.
Caller-supplied new minimum bet value in changeMinBet.
Caller-supplied guessed number in startGame, validated only as <= 10.
Local GameHistory struct instance populated with player and number, then pushed to log.

edges.reason: The owner state variable is initialized directly from the untrusted msg.sender at deployment, making the deployer the privileged account.
The onlyOwner modifier compares the untrusted msg.sender against the stored owner address.
changeMinBet is gated by the onlyOwner modifier, so the access check controls execution.
withdaw is gated by the onlyOwner modifier, so the access check controls execution.
The untrusted caller address is written into the gameHistory.player field and pushed to log.
The untrusted caller is the recipient of the full contract balance transfer, which is an external call.
startGame executes msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) when the guess equals randomNumber, before state is finalized.
withdaw performs an external transfer to the owner address.
block.timestamp (now) is hashed to produce the winning number, making the outcome miner-influenceable.
The timestamp is consumed inside startGame to regenerate randomNumber after every game.
The timestamp-derived randomness operation assigns the new value of the randomNumber state variable.
startGame recomputes randomNumber from the timestamp after each round completes.
The caller-supplied guess parameter flows into startGame's validation and comparison logic.
The guessed number is stored in the log array through gameHistory.number.
The local GameHistory struct is built and pushed into state within startGame.
The local struct instance is pushed into the log state array.
startGame writes to the log state variable via log.push.
startGame reads randomNumber in the comparison and overwrites it with a fresh value.
startGame reads this.balance and assigns it to prizeFund.
startGame reads minBet to validate msg.value.
The new minimum bet parameter is written into changeMinBet's assignment.
changeMinBet overwrites the minBet state variable with the parameter value.
The withdrawal amount parameter flows into withdaw's logic.
The untrusted amount parameter is forwarded to the external transfer call.
Any caller can invoke the payable fallback function to fund the contract.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _newMinBet has no independent semantic identity; it is fully merged into the changeMinBet function that consumes it.
Parameter _number only exists as input to startGame's validation, comparison and log write, so it collapses into startGame.
Parameter _am only exists as the argument of withdaw's transfer and collapses into withdaw.
Local variable gameHistory is a temporary struct constructed and immediately pushed inside startGame, so it merges into startGame.
